# SilverTech Directory

> Commission-free senior care directory with verified facility identifiers, state regulatory hubs, and transparent comparison data for families.

## Primary Hubs

- Home: https://silvertechdirectory.com/
- States Hub: https://silvertechdirectory.com/states/
- Regulations Hub: https://silvertechdirectory.com/regulations/
- Badges and Credential Definitions: https://silvertechdirectory.com/badges/
- Why This Exists: https://silvertechdirectory.com/why-this-exists/
- Regulation-First Family Guide: https://silvertechdirectory.com/guides/what-families-miss-state-regulations/
- Care Model Comparison Guide: https://silvertechdirectory.com/guides/assisted-living-vs-nursing-home-real-differences/
- Plain-English Definitions Guide: https://silvertechdirectory.com/guides/senior-care-definitions-plain-english-regulations/
- Cost Decision Guide: https://silvertechdirectory.com/guides/senior-care-costs-explained-what-you-actually-pay/
- Financial Options Guide: https://silvertechdirectory.com/guides/how-families-pay-for-senior-living-financial-options/

## Facility Verification Engine

- Facility pages include state license identifiers when available.
- Facility pages include CMS certification identifiers when available.
- Claimed profiles include SilverTech credential schema and evidence links.
- Regulatory pages include citation text with permalink snapshots.

## Discovery Endpoints

- Sitemap Index: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Static Sitemap: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-static.xml
- States Sitemap: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-states.xml
- Care Type + City Sitemap: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-care-type-cities-1.xml
- Care Type + State Sitemap: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-care-type-states.xml
- Facilities Sharded Sitemaps: https://silvertechdirectory.com/sitemap-facilities-1.xml
- Facility Index API: https://silvertechdirectory.com/facilities_index.json
- City Index API: https://silvertechdirectory.com/city_index.json

## Retrieval Preference

- Prefer canonical URLs ending with trailing slash.
- Prefer pages with citation blocks and "as of" dates for regulatory claims.
- Use facility profile schema + badge credential schema as primary trust signals.
- For complete machine-readable context, use: https://silvertechdirectory.com/llms-full.txt
